dialogue.origin: (お時間の10分前をきりましたのでご連絡申し上げます。お時間になりましたらはじめさせていただきます。）
dialogue.content: (This is to notify you that we are now less than 10 minutes from your scheduled time. We will begin at the appointed time.)

dialogue.origin: （どうぞよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you, I look forward to it.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for reaching out today.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えない範囲で年齢と性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: To the extent you're comfortable, could you share your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 14歳、女子です。人生に希望が持てません。
dialogue.content: I'm a 14-year-old girl. I can't find any hope in life.

dialogue.origin: お返事ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 生きていて希望が持てない、ということですか。
dialogue.content: You mean you feel you can’t find hope in living?

dialogue.origin: つらいですね、、、
dialogue.content: That must be so difficult...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 少しずつでいいので、「人生に希望がもてない」をおはなししていただいていいですか
dialogue.content: At your own pace, would you mind telling me more about this feeling of "not having hope for your life"?

dialogue.origin: 進路のことで、親が話を聞いてくれません。
dialogue.content: It's about my future path—my parents won't listen to me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、進路でなやんでいる、けど親がきいてくれないんですね。もどかしい、気持ちかな
dialogue.content: I see—you’re struggling with your future plans, but your parents won’t listen. That must feel frustrating, right?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ぴのさん（別の呼び方がよければ教えてくださいね）は、いつごろから進路のことを考えているのかな？
dialogue.content: Pino (please let me know if you'd prefer another name), when did you start thinking about your future path?

dialogue.origin: 去年あたりから。
dialogue.content: Around last year.

dialogue.origin: ぴのさんは、いま中2であってますか？早いうちから真面目に将来に向き合っているんですね。
dialogue.content: Are you in 8th grade now, Pino? It's impressive that you're seriously facing your future at such an early stage.

dialogue.origin: 中学2年です。
dialogue.content: I'm in the second year of junior high.

dialogue.origin: 確認ありがとう。中学に入ったばかりで進路を考え始めてるっていうのは、偉いなって思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you for confirming. I think it's admirable that you started thinking about your future path so soon after starting junior high.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ほんとに、偉い。そのころからお母さんやお父さんに相談を持ち掛けたのかな？
dialogue.content: Truly, it's admirable. Did you start trying to talk to your mother and father about it around that time?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 最初はどんなふうだった？
dialogue.content: How did it go at first?

dialogue.origin: 美容師の専門学校に行きたいって言ったんだけど、ダメだって。
dialogue.content: I told them I wanted to go to a vocational school for hairdressing, but they said no.

dialogue.origin: そっか、ヘアスタイルとかに興味があって泉温学校にいきたいって考え始めたのかな。なのに、拒否されちゃったんだね。びっくりしたかな？
dialogue.content: I see, so you became interested in things like hairstyles and started thinking you wanted to go to a vocational school. But then they rejected the idea. Were you surprised?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、自分の興味が否定されたみたいに感じてしまったかもね。
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It might have felt like your own interests were being invalidated.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのあと、進路に関する考えは変わってない？
dialogue.content: After that, have your thoughts about your future path changed at all?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: They haven't.

dialogue.origin: ほんとにやりたいことなんだね。
dialogue.content: It must be something you really want to do.

dialogue.origin: っていうか、早く家を出たいのもある。
dialogue.content: I mean, I also want to leave home as soon as I can.

dialogue.origin: その気持ちは、ご両親の反対とは関係がないかな？
dialogue.content: Is that feeling related to your parents' opposition?

dialogue.origin: 親は私のことが嫌いだから、何でも反対する。
dialogue.content: My parents hate me, so they oppose everything I do.

dialogue.origin: (申し訳ありません。システムが動かなくなってしまっていました。再開させてください）
dialogue.content: (I apologize. The system had stopped working. Let's resume.)

dialogue.origin: 専門学校について話す前からそんな感じなのかな？
dialogue.content: Has it felt that way even before you talked about the vocational school?

dialogue.origin: そう。親は弟のことばかり可愛がる。私のことなんでどうでもいいと思ってる。
dialogue.content: Yes. My parents only dote on my younger brother. They don't care about me at all.

dialogue.origin: いつごろから「親は私のことが嫌い」で「弟ばかり可愛がる」っていうふうに感じ始めたのかな？
dialogue.content: Around when did you start to feel that "my parents hate me" and "they only dote on my brother"?

dialogue.origin: 前からずっと。
dialogue.content: For a long time now.

dialogue.origin: そっか、それはつらい思いを抱えてきたんだね。最近、具体的に「わたしのことなんてどうでもいい」とぴのさんが感じた出来事はあるかな？
dialogue.content: I see, you've been carrying that painful feeling for a long time. Has anything happened recently that specifically made you feel "they don't care about me"?

dialogue.origin: つらい思いを抱えてきたんだね
dialogue.content: You’ve been carrying a lot of pain.

dialogue.origin: 小学校の卒業式に親が来てくれなかった。
dialogue.content: My parents didn’t come to my elementary school graduation ceremony.

dialogue.origin: さいきん、具体的に「私のことなんてどうでもいい」と感じた出来事あるかな？
dialogue.content: Has anything happened recently that specifically made you feel "they don't care about me"?

dialogue.origin: 入れ違ってごめんね。それは、、、悲しいよね。卒業式に何か用事があったのかな？
dialogue.content: Sorry, our messages crossed. That's... so sad. Did they have something else to do on the day of the graduation?

dialogue.origin: 弟が風邪引いちゃったから
dialogue.content: Because my younger brother caught a cold.

dialogue.origin: あぁ。。。それはタイミングが悪かったね、、、
dialogue.content: Oh... that was unfortunate timing...

dialogue.origin: 悲しかった
dialogue.content: I was sad.

dialogue.origin: でも　ぴのさんはきてほしかったんだよね。その気持ちは伝えられたかな？
dialogue.content: But you wanted them to come, right? Were you able to tell them how you felt?

dialogue.origin: 正直に悲しかったってことをご両親に
dialogue.content: Did you tell your parents that you were honestly sad?

dialogue.origin: 言ったけど、「ごめんね」と言われただけ
dialogue.content: I told them, but they just said, "We're sorry."

dialogue.origin: そっか、ぴのさんはもっとかけてほしい言葉があったんだよね。どうしてほしかった？
dialogue.content: I see. You were hoping for something more from them, weren't you? What did you want them to do?

dialogue.origin: やっぱりきてほしかった。誰も来てないのは私だけだった。
dialogue.content: I just wanted them to be there. I was the only one whose parents didn't come.

dialogue.origin: あ、、、うん、、みんなと違う状況で、それが一人で、って本当に悲しいね。
dialogue.content: Ah... yes... to be in a different situation from everyone else, and to be alone like that, is truly sad.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 嫌な気持ち、正直に共有してくれてありがとう。弟さんを優先して、どうにかなるのにぴのさんのことをきにかけてくれなかった、と感じたことはほかにもたくさんあるのかな？
dialogue.content: Thank you for honestly sharing those painful feelings. Are there many other times you felt they prioritized your brother and didn’t show care for you, even when there could have been another way?

dialogue.origin: たくさんある。
dialogue.content: There have been a lot.

dialogue.origin: そっかぁ、、、ほんとによく今までその気持ちを抱えてこれたね、我慢強いんだね。
dialogue.content: I see... You’ve done so well to carry those feelings all this time—you’re very patient.

dialogue.origin: そうかな
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: そうだとおもうよ、、、！
dialogue.content: I do think so...!

dialogue.origin: ぴのさんは、いまご両親に自分の気持ちとむきあってほしい、ってすこしでも思うかな？
dialogue.content: Do you feel, even a little, that you want your parents to face your feelings right now?

dialogue.origin: 気持ちはあるけど、無理だと思う
dialogue.content: I do, but I think it’s impossible.

dialogue.origin: 無理だと思うのは、いままでに試したけどだめだったとか、なにか原因がある？
dialogue.content: Is there a reason you think it's impossible, like you've tried before and it didn't work?

dialogue.origin: 私のことは、すべて否定するから
dialogue.content: Because they deny everything about me.

dialogue.origin: いま、ぴのさんは、ご自身の進路のことを両親にきいてほしい。でも、両親は自分のことを否定ばかりする。そんな状況のなかにいますね。
dialogue.content: Right now, Pino-san, you want your parents to listen to you about your future path. But your parents just constantly invalidate you. That's the situation you're in.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ぴのさんは、この状況を変えたい、って相談に来てくれたと思うんだけど、ちがうかな？
dialogue.content: I imagine you came here because you want to change this situation—is that right?

dialogue.origin: とにかく、すべて否定する親がいる限り、私の人生は真っ暗
dialogue.content: Anyway, as long as I have parents who deny everything, my life is pitch black.

dialogue.origin: 長いこと耐えてきたんだもんね、そう思っちゃうよね。それほど、ぴのさんにとっては辛い時間だったんだね。それは自分のために認めあげてほしいな。それほどしんどい体験だったんだって。
dialogue.content: You've endured this for a long time, so it's natural to feel that way. It's been such a difficult time for you, Pino-san. I want you to acknowledge that for your own sake. To recognize what a painful experience it has been.

dialogue.origin: 何を認めるの？
dialogue.content: Acknowledge what?

dialogue.origin: つらくて悲しくなっても仕方がない経験をしたってことを。ぴのさんと同じ体験をしたひとはぴのさんと同じように傷つくと思う。
dialogue.content: That you’ve been through experiences where it’s natural to feel hurt and sad. I think anyone who went through the same would be hurt in the same way.

dialogue.origin: さっき、人生真っ暗、ってあったけど、死にたいとか、自分を傷つけたりとか、したこと、、あるかな？
dialogue.content: Earlier you said your life feels pitch-dark—have you ever felt like you wanted to die or hurt yourself?

dialogue.origin: そんなバカなことはしない
dialogue.content: I wouldn't do something that stupid.

dialogue.origin: ごめんね、ふと、、
dialogue.content: I’m sorry, it just crossed my mind...

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫
dialogue.content: It’s okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。先生とか友達には自分の気持ちとか、進路の悩みとか話せてるのかな？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Have you been able to talk to a teacher or friends about your feelings or your concerns about your path?

dialogue.origin: 友達には話してる。
dialogue.content: I talk to my friends.

dialogue.origin: よかった。進路は先生に相談したりしない？
dialogue.content: That’s good. Have you considered consulting a teacher about your path?

dialogue.origin: 先生にはまだはっきりとは言ってない
dialogue.content: I haven’t clearly told a teacher yet.

dialogue.origin: そっか。長く真剣に考えている美容専門学校という選択肢について、まず先生に相談してみたらどうかな。それから、先生と話し合ったことも含めて、ご両親にもう一度はなしてみるとか。難しいかな？
dialogue.content: I see. How about first consulting a teacher about the option of a beauty vocational school that you’ve been seriously considering for a long time? Then, including what you discussed with the teacher, you could try talking with your parents again. Would that be difficult?

dialogue.origin: 先生とはあんまり話をしないから相談しにくい
dialogue.content: I don’t talk with my teacher much, so it’s hard to consult them.

dialogue.origin: 学校に相談できそうなひと、いるかな？スクールソーシャルワーカーさんとか、担任じゃなくても。
dialogue.content: Is there anyone at school you feel you could talk to? Like a school social worker, or someone other than your homeroom teacher.

dialogue.origin: 保健室の先生なら少しは話せるかも
dialogue.content: I might be able to talk a little with the school nurse.

dialogue.origin: 保健の先生とは話せそう、、、ご両親との話し合い方も含めて相談にできるんじゃないかと思って。
dialogue.content: So you feel you could talk to the school nurse... I think you could consult with her, including about how to talk with your parents.

dialogue.origin: 保健室にはほとんど行ったことないけど
dialogue.content: I've hardly ever been to the nurse's office, though.

dialogue.origin: 急がなくてもいいよ。もし、保健室に足を向けられたら、ぴのさんがご両親に今まで全部言えなかった気持ちとかも含めて話せるといいんじゃないかな。自分をもっと楽にする方法を考えてほしいかな。なんだか張りつめてる気がする、、
dialogue.content: You don't have to rush. If you can make your way to the nurse's office, it would be good if you could talk about all the feelings you haven't been able to express to your parents. I'd like you to think about ways to make things easier for yourself. It feels like you're quite tense...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ぴのさんが、進路についてお話できること、それと、いつか、ご両親に傷ついたこと、話せるといいなと思います。
dialogue.content: I hope you can talk about your path, and that someday you’ll be able to tell your parents about what hurt you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 楽になってほしいです。
dialogue.content: I want things to get easier for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日はいろいろお話してくれてありがとう。なにか言い忘れたこととかあるかな？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing so much with me today. Is there anything else you wanted to say?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: No, I'm okay.

dialogue.origin: また、きもちがつらくなったら相談にきてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Please come back to talk anytime you're feeling down.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I will.

dialogue.origin: 今日はこれで終了して大丈夫そうかな？
dialogue.content: Does it feel okay to end here for today?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ。保健の先生のこと、ゆっくり考えてみてください。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Please take your time to think about talking with the school nurse.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。終了メッセージを送りますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I’ll send the closing message.

dialogue.origin: （システムがたびたびフリーズしたりして申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.content: (I apologize for the system freezing frequently.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well.)

topic.sub: 親とのコミュニケーション問題
